cards.oracleText:
Fruitcake Elemental is indestructible.
At the end of your turn, Fruitcake Elemental deals 7 damage to you.
{3}: Target player gains control of Fruitcake Elemental.

cards.name: Freyalise, Skyshroud Partisan
cards.oracleText:
+1: Untap up to one target Elf. That Elf and a random Elf creature card in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.
−1: Seek an Elf card.
−6: Conjure a card named Regal Force onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Fragment Reality
cards.oracleText: Exile target nontoken artifact, creature, or enchantment an opponent controls. Its controller puts a random creature card with lesser mana value from their library onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Frenzied Gorespawn
cards.oracleText:
When this creature enters, for each opponent, goad target creature that player controls. (Until your next turn, those creatures attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)
Whenever one or more creatures attack one of your opponents, those creatures gain menace until end of turn.
